visual_review.method: Text layer (InDesign text, not OCR; 456 pages; printed page = PDF page) read on every cited page by this packet and searched for President, Advani and Joshi in the resolutions headed 1989-1998; the research part rendered and read pages 202, 203, 218, 220, 246, 268 and 292. rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The resolution 'Granting Statehood to Delhi', printed under the heading 'National Executive / Calcutta 06-08 April, 1990', recalls that 'on the 10th of December, 1989, Bharatiya Janata Party President, Shri Lal Krishna Advani was assured by the Prime Minister' that a Bill for a Delhi Legislative Assembly would be prepared before March 1990.

locator.item: National Executive, Calcutta 06-08 April, 1990: 'Granting Statehood to Delhi', first paragraph

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The political resolution 'State Terror against Rath Yatra', printed under 'National Executive / New Delhi 09-10 November, 1990', says 'the BJP President undertook Ram Rath Yatra from Somnath to Ayodhya' and, a few sentences later, that the authorities 'arrested Shri Advani and impounded the Ram Rath' (the source prints the title and, separately, only the surname).

locator.item: National Executive, New Delhi 09-10 November, 1990, Political Resolution: 'State Terror against Rath Yatra', second paragraph

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The resolution 'Jammu and Kashmir Problem', printed under 'National Executive / Varanasi 13-15 March, 1992', says the Ekta Yatra culminated in 'the unfurling of the national flag by our President, Dr. Murli Manohar Joshi, in Lal Chowk in Srinagar on Republic Day, 26 January', and that the National Executive 'hails the Party President on this achievement'.

locator.item: National Executive, Varanasi 13-15 March, 1992: 'Jammu and Kashmir Problem', 'Historic Ekta Yatra', first paragraph

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: Among the demands of the resolution 'Political Situation', printed under 'National Executive / New Delhi 23-24 December, 1992', is the release of 'Dr. Murli Manohar Joshi, President BJP, Shri LK Advani, Leader of Opposition' and other leaders.

locator.item: National Executive, New Delhi 23-24 December, 1992: Political Situation; list of demands, item 2

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The political resolution printed under 'National Executive / New Delhi 27 February, 1993' describes 'The murderous assault on the BJP President, Dr. Murli Manohar Joshi' at the party's rally in New Delhi on 25 February 1993, and under the heading 'Assault on Dr. MM Joshil' (sic) speaks of 'The brutal assault on our President, Dr. Murli Manohar Joshi'.

locator.item: National Executive, New Delhi 27 February, 1993, Political Resolution: 'BJP's Massive Rally' (p.202) and 'Assault on Dr. MM Joshil' (p.203)

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The resolution 'Fabricated Cases against BJP Leaders', printed under 'National Executive / New Delhi 18-19 December, 1993', takes serious note of the cases filed against 'our President, Shri LK Advani' and other leaders.

locator.item: National Executive, New Delhi 18-19 December, 1993: A. Political Situation, 'Fabricated Cases against BJP Leaders', first paragraph

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The same resolution names 'Ex-President, Dr. MM Joshi' among the leaders against whom cases were filed.

locator.item: National Executive, New Delhi 18-19 December, 1993: 'Fabricated Cases against BJP Leaders', first paragraph

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The resolution 'Political Situation', printed under 'National Executive / New Delhi 22-23 February, 1996', says the CBI 'has levelled trumpery charges against our Party President' and, in a later sentence, that 'Shri Advani immediately quit the Parliament' (the source prints the title and, separately, only the surname); the next page speaks of 'Shri Advani's resignation'.

locator.item: National Executive, New Delhi 22-23 February, 1996: Political Situation, 'Method in Rao's Madness' (p.136) and 'CBI Prosecution of the Prime Minister Demanded' (p.137)
